content: Twelve disciples lay on the stones. Jin rested the branch on his shoulder, breathing steadily. 'Your reaction latencies are substandard by zero point four seconds. At this level of proficiency, a third-rate bandit with a cleaver would exterminate this entire hall.'
critique: Sanderson/Gosu: Cold tactical assessment, quantifiable failure metrics.

content: Yu Iseol stepped forward from the shadows, her eyes wide, holding her sword in both hands. She did not raise it in anger. She lowered it, looking from her bruised brothers to the notched branch in Jin's hand. "...Teach me," she whispered. Jin paused, his wolf-eyes studying her silent hunger. "You'll bleed," he said. She nodded once. "I know."
critique: Rothfuss/Inoue: Soulful contrast, Yu Iseol's pure martial longing.

content: "Is this all?!" Jin roared, pointing his stick at Baek Cheon who was groaning in the mud holding his lumpy head. "Twelve grown men beaten black and blue by a fifteen-year-old dried anchovy with a stick he found in a hedge?! You call yourselves Mount Hua?! If our ancestors saw you, they'd dig their way out of their graves just to beat you with their femurs! Get up! GET UP, YOU INCOMPETENT SLUGS!"
critique: Biga/Studio LICO: Absolute Chung Myung volcanic rage, ancestor femur threats.
